messages.body: DL-009 is a boxed armchair, 82 cm wide. Our accepted booking needs a clear route with at least 90 cm usable width, no loose obstacles and no unreported stairs. This is our crew’s checklist, not advice to move heavy furniture yourself.
I have put the small shoes away but I have not confirmed the access requirements. Can you keep the delivery booking for 2026-02-11?

Please confirm whether the route is at least 90 cm wide, clear of loose obstacles, and free of stairs. If it is not, tell us so the delivery team can reassess; do not move heavy items to meet the checklist.
The route measures 96 cm at the narrowest point, is level from the entrance to the room, and is clear of loose items. There are no stairs.

Sena's access details for DL-009 arrived after a vehicle fault removed one of our two-person crews for 2026-02-11. That booking could not be retained. Next available two-person slots: 2026-02-12, 08:00–12:00 or 2026-02-13, 12:00–16:00 UTC.
